title: Length of a doubled word
statement: For any finite binary word $a$, form a new word by replacing each bit with two consecutive copies of itself. The resulting word has length exactly $2|a|$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a finite list of Boolean bits
replaced:
For every binary word $a$, the word obtained from $a$ by replacing each bit $v$ with
$v\,v$ has length exactly $2|a|$.
